entries.label: Button.is_enabled
entries.documentation: Current canonical enabled state.

entries.label: can_drop
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_flip
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_grab
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_press
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: card:flip
entries.documentation: Toggles face orientation; requires the entity to be flippable and a player guard when player-originated.

entries.label: card:set_face_up
entries.documentation: Queues a flip only when the requested orientation differs.

entries.label: Card.definition
entries.documentation: Reads the matching value from the release's definitions map. VM-local edits are neither persisted nor canonical.

entries.label: Card.definition_id
entries.documentation: Identifies the authored card definition.

entries.label: Card.is_face_up
entries.documentation: Current flippable.flipped value when present, otherwise the authored card faceUp value.

entries.label: container:add
entries.documentation: Atomically transfers an entity into this container. index is zero-based and defaults to current length.

entries.label: container:contains
entries.documentation: Tests the single canonical source of membership.

entries.label: container:list
entries.documentation: Returns proxies in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: container:move_to
entries.signature: container:move_to(entity: Entity, target: Container, index?: number)
entries.documentation: Atomically transfers from this container to target; the zero-based index defaults to the target's current length.

entries.label: container:remove
entries.documentation: Atomically removes an entity to world using to = nil, index = 0.

entries.label: Container.count
entries.documentation: Number of contained entities.

entries.label: counter:add
entries.documentation: Adds and clamps to configured bounds.

entries.label: counter:reset
entries.documentation: Restores the canonical component default.

entries.label: counter:set
entries.documentation: Sets and clamps to configured bounds.

entries.label: counter:subtract
entries.documentation: Subtracts and clamps; represented as a negative add because Appendix C has no subtract action.

entries.label: Counter.value
entries.documentation: Current canonical value.

entries.label: data
entries.documentation: An empty namespace reserved for packaged release data; surface only (spec) in creator API v1.

entries.label: deck:draw_to
entries.documentation: Draws canonical top card identity/identities to a container; count defaults to 1.

entries.label: deck:shuffle
entries.documentation: Reorders with canonical RNG; caller never supplies the result.

entries.label: Deck.count
entries.documentation: Number of cards currently in the deck. The last item is top in v1.

entries.label: die:roll
entries.documentation: Uses kernel RNG to choose a valid face; animation cannot choose the result.

entries.label: Die.faces
entries.signature: Die.faces: ordered table of canonical face values
entries.documentation: Authored valid faces. Their order participates in deterministic selection.

entries.label: Die.value
entries.documentation: Current canonical face value.

entries.label: game
entries.documentation: An empty namespace reserved by SPEC 04; surface only (spec) in creator API v1.

entries.label: hand:add
entries.documentation: Transfers an entity into the hand. index is a zero-based insertion index and defaults to the current length (append).

entries.label: hand:contains
entries.documentation: Tests canonical membership.

entries.label: hand:list
entries.documentation: Returns contained proxies in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: hand:remove
entries.documentation: Removes an entity to world using to = nil, index = 0.

entries.label: Hand.count
entries.documentation: Number of contained entities visible through this proxy.

entries.label: on_container_add
entries.documentation: An entity is added to the bound container.

entries.label: on_container_remove
entries.documentation: An entity is removed from the bound container.

entries.label: on_drop
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully dropped.

entries.label: on_enter
entries.documentation: An entity enters the bound zone.

entries.label: on_flip
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully flipped.

entries.label: on_grab
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully grabbed.

entries.label: on_leave
entries.documentation: An entity leaves the bound zone.

entries.label: on_player_join
entries.documentation: After player.joined; ctx.player contains the joined canonical player record and ctx.actor is the system actor.

entries.label: on_press
entries.documentation: The bound button is pressed.

entries.label: on_prompt
entries.documentation: After a valid prompt.respond; context contains promptId, playerId, response, actor, and the responding Player proxy as ctx.player.

entries.label: on_roll
entries.documentation: The bound die is rolled.

entries.label: on_start
entries.documentation: After game.started; context contains canonical settings and actor.

entries.label: Player.hand
entries.documentation: The player's semantic hand when configured.

entries.label: Player.id
entries.documentation: Stable logical participant identity; reconnect keeps the same ID.

entries.label: Player.name
entries.documentation: Canonical player name, falling back to PlayerId when absent.

entries.label: Player.seat
entries.signature: Player.seat: read-only seat record or nil
entries.documentation: Canonical seat assignment shaped as { id = SeatId }.

entries.label: players
entries.documentation: Canonical player lookup and deterministic player ordering; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74).

entries.label: players:by_seat
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: seat_id: SeatId. - Returns: the player assigned to that seat, or nil. - Determinism: canonical seat assignment lookup.

entries.label: players:count
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: none. - Returns: the canonical player count as an integer. - Determinism: counts records in canonical players state.

entries.label: players:get
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: id: PlayerId. - Returns: the matching Player proxy, or nil. - Determinism: stable identity lookup.

entries.label: players:list
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: none. - Returns: an array of Player proxies. - Determinism: seated players use ascending SeatId order; unseated participants follow in ascending PlayerId order. Duplicate seat assignments include a player only at the first SeatId. This order is the basis for deterministic loops such as dealing.

entries.label: random
entries.documentation: Versioned canonical PRNG utilities; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). All methods consume RNG stored in game state. They never use Lua entropy, browser time, or presentation randomness. An aborted transaction discards uncommitted RNG state.

entries.label: random:choice
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: list: table used as an ordered array. - Returns: one deterministic member, or nil for an empty list. - Determinism: selection depends on canonical RNG and the supplied array order. Never build the list from unordered table-key iteration.

entries.label: random:float
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: none. - Returns: the canonical PRNG's deterministic finite value in [0,1). - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG and returns [0,1).

entries.label: random:int
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: safe integers min <= max; the inclusive interval may contain at most 2^32 values. - Returns: a deterministic integer in the inclusive [min,max] range. - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG in a replayable way.

entries.label: random:shuffle
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: list: table used as an ordered array. - Returns: a new shuffled array; the input is unchanged. - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG. This list utility is distinct from Deck:shuffle(), which queues deck.shuffle and never accepts a caller-provided resulting order.

entries.label: refs
entries.documentation: Stable editor-authored entity references; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Missing names evaluate to nil. See refs, settings, props, and self.

entries.label: scene
entries.documentation: Deterministic entity lookup and tag queries; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74).

entries.label: scene:find
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: name: string — authored entity name. - Returns: the first matching entity proxy in ascending EntityId order, or nil. - Determinism: duplicate names resolve by ascending stable EntityId. Prefer refs or stable IDs.

entries.label: scene:get
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: id: EntityId — stable entity identity. - Returns: the matching semantic entity proxy, or nil for a missing ID. - Determinism: identity lookup is canonical; it must not consult renderer objects.

entries.label: scene:query
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: filter: { tags?: string[] }. Every requested tag must be present; an absent tags field returns all entities. - Returns: an array of matching proxies. - Determinism: results use ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: scores
entries.documentation: Deterministic score convenience state stored under canonical state; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74) as luaStdlibVersion: 1. Leader ties use stable player ordering.

entries.label: scores:add
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Adds amount to the prior score (default 0), stores the result, and returns it.

entries.label: scores:get
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Returns the subject's stored value or 0.

entries.label: scores:leader
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Compares players in players:list() order and returns the first player with the highest score, so ties use ascending seat then unseated PlayerId order. Returns nil when there are no players; non-player score subjects are not candidates.

entries.label: scores:set
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Uses a proxy's id or the supplied scalar as the canonical table key, stores value, and returns it. The enclosing state extraction requires the resulting score state to remain canonical and finite.

entries.label: settings
entries.documentation: Read-only canonical room-start settings; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). See refs, settings, props, and self.

entries.label: snap_point:attach
entries.documentation: Attaches if capacity and compatibility allow.

entries.label: SnapPoint.entities
entries.signature: SnapPoint.entities: ordered table of entity proxies
entries.documentation: Entities currently attached in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: SnapPoint.is_occupied
entries.documentation: Whether canonical capacity is occupied.

entries.label: state
entries.documentation: Persistent canonical script data; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). See Persistent state. Reads return the reconstructed canonical value; writes are committed only if the surrounding top-level action succeeds.

entries.label: text:get
entries.documentation: Reads the canonical text value.

entries.label: text:set
entries.documentation: Sets a canonical string of at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes.

entries.label: timer
entries.documentation: Named one-shot callback registration and cancellation; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74).

entries.label: timer:after
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: delay: positive finite number in seconds; callback_name: non-empty string naming a global function in the same script. - Returns: a deterministic TimerId of the form timer_<parentActionId>_<zeroBasedIndex>. - Determinism: queues timer.register with the current script/binding identity and, for an entity binding, its entity ID.

entries.label: timer:cancel
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: timer_id: TimerId. - Returns: nil. - Determinism: queues timer.cancel; the ID must name a scheduled timer. Unknown, fired, or already-canceled timers reject the whole parent transaction.

entries.label: turns
entries.documentation: Deterministic turn convenience state stored under canonical state; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74) as luaStdlibVersion: 1, not a kernel primitive.

entries.label: turns:current
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Returns the current Player proxy, or nil when stopped or when the stored player is no longer present.

entries.label: turns:index
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Returns the stored one-based index. It is 0 before the first start, 1 after starting even with no players, and remains unchanged by stop().

entries.label: turns:is_current
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Accepts a Player proxy or PlayerId and returns whether it matches the current player; nil and stopped turns return false.

entries.label: turns:next
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). When active, advances cyclically through the stored order and returns the next current player; otherwise returns nil.

entries.label: turns:start
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Rebuilds the turn order from players:list(), selects one-based index 1, optionally selects the matching Player or PlayerId, marks turns active only when at least one player exists, and returns turns:current(). An unmatched first leaves index 1 selected.

entries.label: turns:stop
entries.documentation: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). Marks turns inactive without discarding the stored order or index and returns nil.

entries.label: ui
entries.documentation: Structured canonical prompt creation; implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). This namespace does not expose arbitrary DOM or custom UI. A player answers through prompt.respond.

entries.label: ui:confirm
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: non-empty string, title?: string, default?: boolean }. - Returns: schema.id. - Behavior: queues a confirmation prompt. A response must be boolean.

entries.label: ui:number_prompt
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: non-empty string, title?: string, min: finite number, max: finite number, step?: positive finite number, default?: finite number }. - Returns: schema.id. - Behavior: step defaults to 1; min <= max. Defaults and responses must lie inside the inclusive range and make (value - min) / step an integer.

entries.label: ui:prompt
entries.documentation: - Status: implemented (kernel v1, #65 / PR #74). - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: non-empty string, title?: string, choices: non-empty CanonicalValue[], default?: CanonicalValue }. - Returns: schema.id. - Behavior: queues prompt.create with kind choice. The optional default must be canonically equal to one of the choices; the ID must not already exist.

entries.label: zone:contains
entries.documentation: Tests canonical zone membership. Membership is recomputed on semantic placement transitions, not frame physics.

entries.label: Zone.entities
entries.signature: Zone.entities: ordered table of entity proxies
entries.documentation: Current members in ascending stable EntityId order.
